title: Derived comparison for a strict finite scalar tensor model
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E→L and a scheme W. Use compatible scalar-system data A and a derived reduction calculus SE, with ordinary balanced associations a_n as in [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data]. Let direct be any functor from flat-term K-flat complexes over the completed E-coefficient sheaf to complexes of actual L-coefficient systems. Suppose its nth evaluation is naturally the specified ordinary direct finite scalar tensor complex, and suppose those evaluation isomorphisms identify every successor transition with the actual quotient tensor transition. Then there is a natural isomorphism SE.reduction followed by A.scalar.T, restricted to the good representatives, to Q composed with direct. At each finite level it satisfies precisely the model-evaluation equation of [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data]: reduction evaluation, the finite K-flat comparison, the level scalar K-flat counit, then a_n.

source.place: Proof of stage3-pur-extension-strict-representatives, step 2 (derived comparison); Stacks 03D7, 06YY, 07A6 and 0941.

proof.text: Obtain an ordinary E-quotient tensor model M. Use the natural reduction cochain counit epsilon, the normalized ordinary scalar-evaluation comparison rho and the ordinary strict association beta. Form gamma by scalar extension of epsilon, the system scalar cochain counit and Q(beta). Every factor is a natural transformation before evaluation.

Naturality of exact-evaluation localization factors moves Q(beta) past evaluation. Substitute the ordinary association equation and the scalar cochain counit equation. Naturality of A.evaluation and the finite scalar counit then reduces the result to the reduction cochain evaluation identity. This yields exactly IsCoefficientExtensionModelEvaluation, by explicit composition equalities.

Finite reduction preserves K-flatness by coefficientTensorModelPreservation. The finite scalar counit is therefore invertible by its computes field. All remaining factors in the displayed finite equation are isomorphisms, so cancellation makes each evaluated gamma component invertible. The coefficient calculus isIso_iff_evaluations field jointly detects isomorphisms; hence gamma is a natural isomorphism. Its hom retains the already proved evaluation identity.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientExtensionStrictDerivedComparison
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
        integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι W A association)
    (direct : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory ⥤
      CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L W) ℤ)
    (directEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
      direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n)
    (htransition : IsCoefficientExtensionStrictTransition l E L ι W direct directEvaluation) :
    ∃ model : integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W ⋙
        coefficientExtensionSystem l E L ι W SE A ≅ direct ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      IsCoefficientExtensionModelEvaluation l E L ι W SE A association direct
        directEvaluation model
